name: Collective Bargaining Agreement — Store Associates
step_basis: Years of continuous service from union seniority date; step increase effective on the anniversary.

overtime.note: Hours over 35 in the Sun–Sat week at time and a half; all Sunday hours at double time. Premium hours are not paid twice.

clauses.title: Full-time week
clauses.text: The full-time work week for covered associates is 35 hours, Sunday through Saturday.

clauses.title: Overtime
clauses.text: Hours worked over 35 in the work week are paid at time and a half. Monday through Saturday hours within 35 are straight time.

clauses.title: Sunday premium
clauses.text: All hours worked on Sunday are paid at double time. Premium hours are not paid twice (no pyramiding).

clauses.title: Wage scale
clauses.text: Covered associates are paid at least the step rate for their title and years of continuous service from the union seniority date.

clauses.title: Step increases
clauses.text: A step increase takes effect on the associate's service anniversary.
